transitions.label: POST {id}/reverse
transitions.note: Refused 422 POSTING_ALREADY_REVERSED if already reversed under a new key; refused per the account's own status gate in the reversal's direction

cards.title: One-way and once only
items: MarkReversedBy throws if called twice — a posting can be reversed at most once
There is no path back to Posted: a mistake is corrected by a new posting, never by editing this one

cards.title: A reversal is itself a Posting
items: The reversing entry starts at Posted like any other — see Reverse a Posting for how the two rows link
